description: This file contains a function to sanitize HTML content for plain-text messaging, primarily converting HTML tags like <b>, <i>, <s>, <code>, <h1>-<h6>, and list items into lightweight markups suitable for messaging platforms such as WhatsApp, Signal, Clipboard, and others. It handles converting inline HTML tags to lightweight equivalents, preserves URLs within angle brackets, and strips remaining HTML tags.

methods.name: export function sanitizeForPlainText(text: string): string { sanitizeForPlainText
methods.description: Converts common HTML tags to lightweight markup equivalents and strips remaining HTML tags, aiming to produce plain-text suitable for messaging surfaces.
